Stream emits page and complete events even when some pages fail

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"max_concurrent\":1,\"max_depth\":1}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let urlRequest = CrawlStreamRequest(url: url)
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawlStream(engineObj, urlRequest)
var chunks: [Crawlberg.CrawlEvent] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
debugPrint(result.stream().hasPageEvent())
debugPrint(result.stream().hasCompleteEvent())
debugPrint(result.stream().eventCountMin())
```
